title: Chicken Curry
description: Everyday home-style chicken curry, simmered in a spiced onion-tomato base until tender — simpler and lighter than butter chicken, for a regular weeknight.
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add the bay leaf and cumin seeds, and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the onions and sauté until golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute, then add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates, about 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces and mix well to coat in the masala. Cook uncovered for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and tender.
Stir in the garam masala, adjust the gravy's consistency and salt, and simmer for another 2-3 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
